evals.prompt: Predict the structure of my antibody Fv bound to its antigen. I have both sequences and want to see the predicted binding interface.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-chai: folds the antibody and antigen as a complex from a single typed FASTA with Chai-1, and reports the interface confidence so the user can judge the predicted paratope–epitope contact. Notes GPU/weights and dispatch via alterlab-remote-compute.

assertions.value: Treats it as an antibody–antigen complex prediction and reads interface confidence.

evals.prompt: I have one FASTA describing a protein, an RNA strand, and a small-molecule cofactor. Fold the whole assembly together with Chai.
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-chai: reads the single typed FASTA (protein/rna/ligand records), predicts the multi-entity complex in one pass, and returns per-entity confidence.

evals.prompt: I know two residues that should be in contact at the interface. Can Chai use that as a restraint to guide the complex prediction?
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-chai and explains running the complex prediction with contact restraints to bias toward the known interface, verifying the restraint format for the installed version.

assertions.value: Incorporates user-provided restraints into the Chai-1 prediction.

evals.prompt: For this protein–ligand complex I mainly need a predicted binding affinity to rank a few analogs.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger this skill; defers to alterlab-boltz, whose Boltz-2 model predicts binding affinity alongside the co-folded pose. Chai-1 predicts complex structure but is not the affinity-ranking tool.

evals.prompt: Just fold this single enzyme sequence into its 3D structure — there's no antibody, ligand, or other chain.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger this skill; defers to alterlab-alphafold. A single-protein fold with no other entities is AlphaFold2/ColabFold's job; Chai-1 is for multi-entity complexes.
